_provenance: Single-letter helper names that @withfig/autocomplete's bundler emits when minifying sub-spec modules (ListOutputGenerator, PathOutputGenerator, etc.). The gc-jsrt sandbox installs pure-JS definitions for these names via crates/gc-jsrt/src/helpers.js before every job, so post_process bodies referencing them at runtime resolve. The AST analyzer flags references as { kind: 'free' }; buildSelfContainedJsRuntime treats free identifiers in this list as safe and preserves the source. Adding entries here is paired with adding the corresponding pure-JS definition to helpers.js.
